issues.description: The recommendation to manually check 10–20 random cases appears in other sections of the memory (e.g. prompt templates and generators). In the current section the advice is labelled as "general background knowledge" but lacks an explicit inline citation to the earlier checklist.

issues.description: The LaTeX body uses Unicode en-dashes for numeric ranges (e.g. "0–4"). Some LaTeX toolchains prefer explicit -- for ranges. Nested itemize/enumerate looks syntactically fine but verify encoding/packages.
issues.required_fix: Replace Unicode en-dashes in numeric ranges with LaTeX-compatible '--' (e.g. '0--4') or ensure the document preamble declares UTF-8 input handling (\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}) and that the target build supports Unicode.

issues.description: The section is practical but would benefit from a short concrete example: a filled example rubric row, a sample prompt used for LLM pre-evaluation, and an example audit log entry.
issues.required_fix: Add one minimal worked example (one student answer, LLM pre-score + comment, human correction and final score) and a short sample prompt template referencing 3-2 so readers can see the full loop. If no vetted example is available yet, mark this as an open TODO and request retrieval of case studies.
